XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Rear parking aid malfunction when reverse gear is engaged
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: B107C | REVERSE | BACK | SENSORS | WARNING | AUDIBLE | ALARM | WORKS | WARNS | PART | SECONDS | TURNS OFF | SUBSEQUENTLY | IMMEDIATELY | SIGNAL | FRONT | CORRECT | CORRECTLY | NORMAL | ADAS |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: ADAS

  • Device: Rear parking warning buzzer

  • Fault: The rear parking sensor buzzer activates briefly when reverse gear is engaged, then deactivates after a few moments.
    The front parking aid continues to function normally.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: B107C (Parking aid buzzer - Malfunction/error)

  • Cause: Faulty rear parking sensor buzzer

• Action: Check that the rear parking warning buzzer is working properly and replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Notes: After replacement, no adjustment using diagnostic equipment was necessary. In this case, the defective buzzer did not show any visual abnormalities.
    The component is accessible from the rear boot, on the passenger side, attached to the top of the bodywork.
